title: The Digital Twin
short_teaser: Engineers create virtual models of physical systems to test changes and monitor performance.
story: Engineers create virtual models of physical systems to test changes and monitor performance. A useful copy can help protect and improve the original. Innovation is usually a chain of observations, tests, failures, adjustments, and connections. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A useful copy can help protect and improve the original. Innovation is usually a chain of observations, tests, failures, adjustments, and connections.
